title: GENERAL Super Loto retrospective audit
scope: Current repository source files and unit tests
Current super_loto_archive.json metadata and row structure
GitHub Actions runs for method candidate tests and evaluation

confirmed_prior_errors.finding: A previous assistant response attributed an old method description to V17 without a source artifact/version trace that independently proves the attribution.
confirmed_prior_errors.correction: Withdraw that attribution as unverified. The three implementations remain explicitly experimental and OPEN_DEFINITION.

confirmed_prior_errors.finding: Contiguous folds of the same expanding-window walk-forward scores were described as cross-validation too strongly.
confirmed_prior_errors.correction: Renamed output to chronological_fold_summaries; explicitly states these are summaries of the same walk-forward predictions, not nested CV and not per-fold model selection.

confirmed_prior_errors.finding: Prior candidate evaluation compared only observed mean hits with the theoretical 0.6 baseline and did not quantify random-pick variation.
confirmed_prior_errors.correction: Added a reproducible 1000-replication Monte Carlo random 6-of-60 reference scored against the same historical test draws; reports a 95% interval and one-sided tail probability. This is descriptive and does not adjust for multiple hypotheses.

confirmed_prior_errors.finding: evaluate_rows accepted a generic iterable but passed it to validate_archive before materializing it; a one-shot generator could be consumed before evaluation.
confirmed_prior_errors.correction: Materialize rows once before validation; added a generator-input regression test.

confirmed_prior_errors.finding: The previous description did not clearly distinguish structural Data Guard checks from independent source verification of all years.
confirmed_prior_errors.correction: Current archive metadata shows the explicit cross-source comparison covers 2025 only (156 records). Do not describe all years as independently cross-verified.

random_reference.method: Monte Carlo random 6-of-60 picks on the exact same historical target draws

latest_candidate_results.interpretation: No candidate demonstrates clear evidence of advantage in this descriptive comparison. Do not treat the tail probabilities as definitive inferential p-values or as proof of absence/presence of a mechanism.

open_items_not_to_hide.issue: Exact V17/V19 source artifacts and original formula definitions were not found among accessible Library artifacts; available historical source code artifacts include v1, v1.2, v1.3, V8.5 FAST, and V8.6 transformation discovery. These do not prove the V17/V19 canonical formulas.
open_items_not_to_hide.required_action: Locate exact V17/V19 source files or commits before claiming exact reproduction. Keep candidate definitions experimental.

open_items_not_to_hide.issue: Current archive generator cross-source validation explicitly covers 2025 only. Other years are structurally validated but not all independently cross-verified against a second source.
open_items_not_to_hide.required_action: Add independent source checks for all years or label their verification scope precisely.

open_items_not_to_hide.issue: The current candidate module does not implement full nested time-series cross-validation or multiple-hypothesis correction.
open_items_not_to_hide.required_action: If model/feature tuning begins, implement nested chronological validation and multiple-hypothesis control before claiming a selected winner.

next_step_blocked_until: Run the new read-only cross-source audit against live sources, inspect parse/coverage warnings, and locate exact V17/V19 artifacts before any canonical method claim or tuning.

resolved_findings.finding: 2025 count discrepancy: 160 in some earlier memory/version notes vs 156 in current archive.
resolved_findings.evidence: Current archive contains 156 2025 rows. The embedded 2025 draw sequences in accessible legacy v1 and v1.2 scripts each contain 156 records and match current archive's 2025 number sets row-by-row in chronological order (156/156). The prior 155 count came from a line-anchored extraction that missed the first record because it shared the ARCHIVE declaration line. The 160 value is unsupported by the available row-level evidence and is erroneous for the current verified archive.

resolved_findings.finding: R54 and R60 number-pool regimes were not being separated in the experimental candidate evaluation.
resolved_findings.evidence: Current archive has 31 records before 2020-08-02 and 66 records from that date onward in 2020; pre-boundary records have maximum number 54 and post-boundary records include numbers up to 60. Candidate engine now rejects pre-R60 target dates and filters all pre-2020-08-02 records out of R60 analysis.

current_candidate_evaluation_after_regim.interpretation: No candidate demonstrates clear advantage in this descriptive comparison; tail probabilities are not adjusted for multiple hypotheses.

capabilities: Read-only archive audit; never overwrites super_loto_archive.json
Compares dates and six-number sets internally but does not output number sets
Reports yearly Loto.gen.tr comparisons, R54-era comparison, R60 comparison, parse failures, source lag and mismatches
Does not invoke candidate analysis or include the isolated target's numbers in model requests
new_audit_tool.caution: Parser and comparison unit tests passed. The new tool has not yet been run against live external sources; its real-world parsing and source coverage remain unverified.

v17_v19_search.conclusion: Exact V17/V19 source artifacts were not found in the accessible repository code search. This is not proof that no copies exist in other branches, prior chats, or user files.
